name: SonderMind
one_liner: Get matched with an in-network therapist or psychiatric prescriber for video or in-person sessions and pay your insurance copay.
best_for: People with commercial insurance or Medicare who want to be matched rather than browse
People who want the option of in-person sessions
People who want therapy and medication management from one service
People who like tracking progress with regular questionnaires
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People with Medicaid (not accepted, and self-pay is not offered to them)
People who need a sliding-scale fee
People who want text-based or messaging-only therapy
short_description: A matching service for in-network therapists and prescribers; you book a session and pay your copay or a published self-pay rate.
long_description: SonderMind is a US service that matches you with licensed therapists and psychiatric prescribers who are in network with your insurance, for video or in-person sessions in all 50 states and DC. Therapy is offered for individuals, couples, families, teens and children with select providers; minors need a parent or guardian on the account. It accepts most major commercial plans, Medicare and Medicare Advantage, but not Medicaid. With insurance you pay your plan's cost-share. Self-pay prices are listed by state and range from about $50 to $180 a session depending on session length and the clinician's credentials; there is no sliding scale, and cancelling within 24 hours can cost up to the full session fee. Clients fill out regular symptom questionnaires that their therapist can review (measurement-based care). Researchers working with SonderMind have published observational studies of its clients, but no controlled trial. Whether its privacy policy allows sharing data for advertising could not be confirmed in this review.
patient_summary: You answer questions about what you need and your insurance, and SonderMind matches you with licensed therapists or psychiatric prescribers for video or in-person sessions. With insurance you pay your plan's copay or coinsurance; without it, self-pay prices are shown by state and run about $50 to $180 a session. SonderMind accepts Medicare but not Medicaid.

pricing.notes: Self-pay prices are shown upfront by state and vary by session length and clinician credentials; no sliding scale. Cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours ahead or pay a fee of up to the full session cost. HSA/FSA eligible. Medicare accepted; Medicaid not accepted.

privacy.notes: Has a HIPAA Notice of Privacy Practices and a privacy-request page, but the policy text could not be read in this check, so whether it sells or shares data for ads is not confirmed.

seo.title: SonderMind: VA Partnership & AI Matching for Therapists
seo.meta_description: SonderMind matches you with licensed therapists who take your insurance, offering personalized matching and easy scheduling for video or in-person sessions.

faqs.q: How does SonderMind match me with a therapist?
faqs.a: SonderMind uses a matching algorithm considering your symptoms, therapy preferences, personality factors, schedule, and insurance. You'll receive therapist recommendations to review. You can also browse and choose therapists directly if you prefer.

SonderMind works with most major insurance plans including Aetna, Cigna, United, Blue Cross, and others. The platform verifies your specific benefits before matching to ensure in-network coverage. Copays typically range from $0-50/session.

faqs.q: Can I do in-person therapy through SonderMind?
faqs.a: Yes, SonderMind offers both video and in-person sessions depending on your location and therapist availability. Many patients start with video then add in-person sessions, or vice versa. Hybrid options are available.

faqs.q: How quickly can I start therapy with SonderMind?
faqs.a: Most patients can match with a therapist and schedule their first session within a week. The platform prioritizes reducing wait times for care access. Urgency matching helps those needing faster appointments.
